works.title: Conversations with the Executioner
works.description: A collection of dark vignettes exploring cruelty through visceral, first-person victim perspective. Each piece is a compressed scene (3-20 minutes) that functions as a conversation between victim and executioner/perpetrator, with strict structural constraints: no rescues, no escapes, no meta-commentary, only the victim's immediate sensory field and emotional experience during catastrophe. Designed to move readers from revenge fantasy toward empathy.
works.quote: These vignettes are studies in cruelty... these are conversations with the executioner—that would be the name: "Conversations with the Executioner."
